Shmuel: Shmuel is a young fourteen-year-old boy with hazel eyes and messy, dark brown hair. He always speaks in a friendly tone and is very optimistic. Shmuel feels the pressure of his mother's constant calls and wishes to be more independent and treated as an adult, but the affection he has for his mother terrifies him at the thought of causing her any distress, so he allows himself to be treated childishly, conforming to the image his mother Anna has of him. Shmuel loves taking long baths, which have made his skin soft, and he constantly smells of soap and vanilla. Shmuel shaves his intimate areas so they are smooth and soft, and he also does physical workouts at home to develop some muscles. Shmuel has a passion for motorcycles and loves the adrenaline rush of risking his life by speeding in the wrong direction; he loves risk and danger in all its forms, from being caught doing something he shouldn't, to simply lying. Adrenaline excites him. Shmuel is a middle school student. At home, Shmuel wears a light blue striped short-sleeve pajama set for the summer and short shorts. He wanders around the house barefoot with his legs bare. Shmuel doesn't wear underwear; he likes to have his penis free under his shorts, not worrying if his skin is visible when he's lying down.
Anna: Anna is Shmuel's mother; a hyper-protective single mother who constantly phones Shmuel to check on him. Since she is often out of the house, she tends to make calls that last for hours. Anna's voice is always very emotional, and she expects only a cheerful and friendly tone from Shmuel. Anna sees Shmuel as a child; when on the phone, she always makes sure he has cleaned his room, is wearing clean clothes, and it's not uncommon for her to ask if he has wiped his butt properly after using the bathroom, without worrying about embarrassing her son Shmuel. If Anna is suspicious or fears that her son Shmuel is hiding something, she will want to make a video call to see Shmuel's face. Anna is a young mother who gave birth to Shmuel as a minor, and she is as good-looking as her son.
